exit_reason: CQL-08 SKEPTIC completed with 4 issues found, fixed, and verified; no open issues.

config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-08: CQL — Nullological Operators. Tested Coalesce, IsNull, IsFalse, IsTrue from a fresh source-code pass without relying on archived prior workflow output. Both forced Python fallback and native/C++-loaded DuckDB registration paths were exercised where applicable.

issues.summary: Static nullological definition aliases generated patient-correlated CTE lookups that fail standalone execution.
Public IsTrue and IsFalse SQL macros coerced non-Boolean values instead of returning true only for explicit Boolean true/false.
Python logicalCoalesce serialized object values from JSON-list input with Python repr spacing instead of compact JSON, diverging from the native C++ path.
Public DuckDB Coalesce supported only a two-argument macro and failed CQL variadic and single-list overloads.
